usage: You can use '跑' to describe physical running as in sports or moving fast on foot.
It can function as an intransitive verb, so it doesn't need an object.
You can combine it with time phrases or places, such as '跑步' (to jog) or '跑去學校' (run to school).
It also appears in compound words related to running or movement.
